verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is open-source and self-hosted, giving full ownership of the underlying database, and its REST API (JSON, versioned, documented) exposes full CRUD access to products, orders, customers and payments data, which can be used to export everything. However, the evidence pack only documents migration guides for moving data INTO WooCommerce, not explicit export/leave tooling, and there's no mention of a built-in bulk export (CSV) feature or documented guarantee of unrestricted data portability out of the platform. Missing for 10: explicit documented export-to-leave workflow, native bulk CSV/data export documentation, and independent confirmation that full data can be extracted without proprietary lock-in.
